claim: In the matching retail DLL, uAudio.uAudioPlayer.get_CurrentTime (0x060052D6) is an instance parameterless getter with exact signature blob 20001182c1 and an exact 41-byte body. It first tests this._uAudio (0x040087E3); a null value takes the stored fallback path. It then tests this.State (0x040087E9); raw zero also takes the stored fallback path. Only when _uAudio is non-null and State is nonzero does it call uAudio.uAudio_backend.uAudio.get_CurrentTime through memberref 0x0A000FB8 and return that result. The shared fallback loads and returns this.endSongTime (0x040087F2). FACT-0126 pins the already-canonical caller at SongEnd IL+0x0002.
